# Best Practices for Native Component Development

This document outlines best practices for converting Angular components to native web components using GitHub Copilot.

## 🎯 Core Principles

### 1. HTML-First Architecture ⭐ **MOST IMPORTANT**

**The Golden Rule**: Component structure must be explicit in HTML, NOT generated by JavaScript.

#### ✅ DO THIS
```html
<!-- button.html - Explicit structure -->
<button class="vf-button vf-button--primary" data-component="button">
  <span class="vf-button__icon">
    <i class="icon-chevron"></i>
  </span>
  <span class="vf-button__label">Click me</span>
</button>
```

```javascript
// button.js - Enhancement only
export class VfButton {
  constructor(element) {
    this.element = element;
    this.icon = element.querySelector('.vf-button__icon');
    this.label = element.querySelector('.vf-button__label');
    
    // Enhance existing structure
    this.element.addEventListener('click', this.handleClick.bind(this));
  }
  
  setLabel(text) {
    // Update content, don't recreate structure
    this.label.textContent = text;
  }
}
```

#### ❌ DON'T DO THIS
```javascript
// BAD: Generating structure with JavaScript
export class VfButton {
  constructor(container) {
    // ❌ NO! Don't create structure in JS
    container.innerHTML = `
      <button class="vf-button">
        <span class="vf-button__icon"></span>
        <span class="vf-button__label">Click me</span>
      </button>
    `;
  }
}
```

**Why?**
- ✅ Works with server-side rendering (Liferay)
- ✅ Works without JavaScript
- ✅ SEO-friendly
- ✅ Progressive enhancement
- ✅ Easier to understand and maintain
- ✅ Liferay can inject content directly

### 2. Design Token-Driven Styling

**Never hard-code visual values.**

#### ✅ DO THIS
```css
.vf-button {
  background-color: var(--vf-color-primary);
  padding: var(--vf-space-md) var(--vf-space-lg);
  border-radius: var(--vf-border-radius-md);
  font-size: var(--vf-font-size-base);
  transition: background-color var(--vf-transition-duration) var(--vf-transition-easing);
}
```

#### ❌ DON'T DO THIS
```css
.vf-button {
  background-color: #e60000; /* ❌ Hard-coded */
  padding: 16px 24px;        /* ❌ Hard-coded */
  border-radius: 8px;        /* ❌ Hard-coded */
  font-size: 16px;           /* ❌ Hard-coded */
  transition: background-color 0.2s ease; /* ❌ Hard-coded */
}
```

### 3. Separation of Concerns

Each technology has its role:

| Technology | Responsibility | Example |
|------------|---------------|---------|
| **HTML** | Structure, content, semantics | `<button>`, `<article>`, ARIA |
| **CSS** | Presentation, layout, styling | Colors, spacing, responsive |
| **JavaScript** | Behavior, state, interactions | Click handlers, validation |

#### ✅ DO THIS
```html
<!-- HTML: Structure -->
<button class="vf-button" disabled data-component="button">
  <span class="vf-button__label">Submit</span>
</button>
```

```css
/* CSS: Styling */
.vf-button:disabled {
  opacity: 0.5;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}
```

```javascript
// JavaScript: Behavior
class VfButton {
  enable() {
    this.element.removeAttribute('disabled');
  }
  
  disable() {
    this.element.setAttribute('disabled', '');
  }
}
```

## 📋 Development Workflow

### Phase 1: Discovery (Run Once)

```bash
# Discover components from Angular library
npm run discover

# Check status
npm run status
```

**Output:**
```
✅ Found 10 component directories

💡 Suggested next component to convert:
   📦 button
   Use: @native-ui-engineer analyze the button component
```

### Phase 2: Analysis

**In GitHub Copilot Chat:**
```
@native-ui-engineer analyze the button component from 
https://github.com/Mohamed-Adel-Web/vf-UI-components/tree/master/projects/ui/src/lib/button
```

**Agent will:**
1. Fetch Angular component files
2. Analyze structure, props, events
3. Extract design tokens
4. Document accessibility patterns
5. Create `docs/component-analysis/button.md`

**Best Practices:**
- ✅ Review the analysis document
- ✅ Verify all variants are captured
- ✅ Confirm accessibility patterns
- ✅ Check for dependencies on other components

### Phase 3: Conversion

**In GitHub Copilot Chat:**
```
@native-ui-engineer convert the button component to native following 
the HTML-first principle
```

**Best Practices:**

#### File Structure
```
src/components/button/
├── button.html          # ⭐ Explicit HTML structure
├── button.css           # 🎨 Token-driven styles
├── button.js            # ⚡ Behavior enhancement
├── button.test.js       # ✅ Unit tests
└── README.md            # 📚 Documentation
```

#### HTML Template
```html
<!--
  Component: Button
  Usage: Include this template and initialize with VfButton class
  
  Variants: primary, secondary, outline, ghost
  Sizes: small, medium, large
  States: default, hover, active, focus, disabled, loading
-->

<button 
  class="vf-button vf-button--primary vf-button--medium" 
  data-component="button"
  type="button"
>
  <!-- Optional icon (use hidden attribute when not needed) -->
  <span class="vf-button__icon" hidden>
    <i class="icon-placeholder"></i>
  </span>
  
  <!-- Label (always present) -->
  <span class="vf-button__label">Button Text</span>
  
  <!-- Optional badge -->
  <span class="vf-button__badge" hidden>
    3
  </span>
</button>
```

**Key Points:**
- ✅ Include ALL elements in HTML (even optional ones)
- ✅ Use `hidden` attribute for initially hidden elements
- ✅ Add comments explaining structure
- ✅ Include `data-component` for JavaScript targeting
- ✅ Include all necessary ARIA attributes

#### CSS Styling
```css
/**
 * Button Component
 * Framework-independent button with variants and states
 */

/* Base styles - mobile first */
.vf-button {
  /* Layout */
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--vf-space-sm);
  
  /* Spacing */
  padding: var(--vf-space-md) var(--vf-space-lg);
  
  /* Colors */
  background-color: var(--vf-color-primary);
  color: var(--vf-color-on-primary);
  border: none;
  
  /* Typography */
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: var(--vf-font-size-base);
  font-weight: var(--vf-font-weight-medium);
  line-height: var(--vf-line-height-base);
  text-decoration: none;
  white-space: nowrap;
  
  /* Borders */
  border-radius: var(--vf-border-radius-md);
  
  /* Interaction */
  cursor: pointer;
  user-select: none;
  
  /* Transitions */
  transition: 
    background-color var(--vf-transition-duration) var(--vf-transition-easing),
    transform var(--vf-transition-duration) var(--vf-transition-easing);
}

/* Variants */
.vf-button--primary {
  background-color: var(--vf-color-primary);
  color: var(--vf-color-on-primary);
}

.vf-button--secondary {
  background-color: var(--vf-color-secondary);
  color: var(--vf-color-on-secondary);
}

/* Sizes */
.vf-button--small {
  padding: var(--vf-space-sm) var(--vf-space-md);
  font-size: var(--vf-font-size-sm);
  min-height: 32px;
}

.vf-button--medium {
  padding: var(--vf-space-md) var(--vf-space-lg);
  font-size: var(--vf-font-size-base);
  min-height: 40px;
}

/* States */
.vf-button:hover {
  background-color: var(--vf-color-primary-hover);
}

.vf-button:focus {
  outline: 2px solid var(--vf-color-focus);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.vf-button:disabled {
  opacity: 0.5;
  cursor: not-allowed;
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* RTL Support - Use logical properties */
.vf-button {
  /* Use margin-inline-start instead of margin-left */
  /* Use padding-inline instead of padding-left/right */
}

/* Responsive - Mobile first */
@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .vf-button {
    min-height: 44px; /* Larger touch targets on mobile */
  }
}

/* Reduced motion */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .vf-button {
    transition: none;
  }
}
```

**Key Points:**
- ✅ Use design tokens exclusively
- ✅ Logical properties for RTL support
- ✅ Mobile-first responsive design
- ✅ All states (hover, focus, active, disabled)
- ✅ Reduced motion support
- ✅ Clear comments and organization

#### JavaScript Behavior
```javascript
/**
 * Button Component
 * 
 * @example
 * const button = document.querySelector('[data-component="button"]');
 * const vfButton = new VfButton(button);
 * button.addEventListener('vf-button:click', (e) => console.log('Clicked!'));
 */

import { dispatch } from '../../utils/events.js';

export class VfButton {
  constructor(element, options = {}) {
    if (!element) {
      throw new Error('VfButton requires an element');
    }

    this.element = element;
    this.options = {
      variant: element.dataset.variant || 'primary',
      size: element.dataset.size || 'medium',
      ...options
    };

    // Get child elements (don't create them!)
    this.icon = element.querySelector('.vf-button__icon');
    this.label = element.querySelector('.vf-button__label');
    this.badge = element.querySelector('.vf-button__badge');

    // State
    this.state = {
      disabled: element.hasAttribute('disabled'),
      loading: element.classList.contains('vf-button--loading')
    };

    this.init();
  }

  init() {
    this.applyVariant();
    this.applySize();
    this.setupAccessibility();
    this.attachEventListeners();
  }

  setupAccessibility() {
    if (!this.element.hasAttribute('type')) {
      this.element.setAttribute('type', 'button');
    }
  }

  attachEventListeners() {
    this.handleClick = this.handleClick.bind(this);
    this.element.addEventListener('click', this.handleClick);
  }

  handleClick(event) {
    if (this.state.disabled || this.state.loading) {
      event.preventDefault();
      return;
    }

    dispatch(this.element, 'vf-button:click', {
      button: this.element,
      variant: this.options.variant,
      originalEvent: event
    });
  }

  // Public API
  enable() {
    this.state.disabled = false;
    this.element.removeAttribute('disabled');
  }

  disable() {
    this.state.disabled = true;
    this.element.setAttribute('disabled', '');
  }

  setIcon(iconClass) {
    if (this.icon) {
      const iconElement = this.icon.querySelector('i');
      if (iconElement) {
        iconElement.className = iconClass;
        this.icon.hidden = false;
      }
    }
  }

  destroy() {
    this.element.removeEventListener('click', this.handleClick);
    delete this.element._vfButton;
  }
}

// Auto-initialize
if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-component="button"]').forEach(el => {
      if (!el._vfButton) {
        el._vfButton = new VfButton(el);
      }
    });
  });
}
```

**Key Points:**
- ✅ Find elements, don't create them
- ✅ Clear public API
- ✅ Proper event cleanup
- ✅ Custom events for communication
- ✅ Auto-initialization
- ✅ JSDoc comments

### Phase 4: Testing

```bash
# Run tests
npm test

# Test in playground
npm run dev
```

**Manual Testing Checklist:**
- [ ] All variants render correctly
- [ ] All sizes work
- [ ] All states work (hover, focus, disabled)
- [ ] Keyboard navigation works (Tab, Enter, Space)
- [ ] RTL layout works (toggle in playground)
- [ ] Responsive at all sizes (mobile, tablet, desktop)
- [ ] Screen reader announces correctly
- [ ] No console errors

### Phase 5: Validation

**In GitHub Copilot Chat:**
```
@native-ui-engineer validate the button component
```

**Best Practices:**
- ✅ Run automated tests (`npm test`)
- ✅ Check accessibility with browser tools
- ✅ Test with screen readers (NVDA, VoiceOver)
- ✅ Verify keyboard navigation
- ✅ Test in multiple browsers
- ✅ Check responsive behavior

### Phase 6: Documentation

Update `README.md` for the component:

```markdown
# Button Component

Framework-independent button with variants and states.

## Usage

### HTML
\`\`\`html
<button class="vf-button vf-button--primary" data-component="button">
  <span class="vf-button__label">Click me</span>
</button>
\`\`\`

### JavaScript
\`\`\`javascript
import { VfButton } from './components/button/button.js';

const button = new VfButton(element, {
  variant: 'primary',
  size: 'medium'
});
\`\`\`

## Variants
- `primary` - Main call-to-action
- `secondary` - Secondary actions
- `outline` - Low-emphasis actions
- `ghost` - Minimal emphasis

## API
- `enable()` - Enable the button
- `disable()` - Disable the button
- `setIcon(className)` - Set icon class

## Events
- `vf-button:click` - Dispatched on click

## Accessibility
- Semantic `<button>` element
- Keyboard accessible (Enter, Space)
- Screen reader friendly
- WCAG 2.1 AA compliant
```

## 🚫 Common Mistakes to Avoid

### 1. Dynamic DOM Generation ❌

**Wrong:**
```javascript
function createButton(text) {
  const button = document.createElement('button');
  button.innerHTML = `<span>${text}</span>`;
  return button;
}
```

**Right:**
```javascript
// HTML already has structure
function updateButton(element, text) {
  const label = element.querySelector('.vf-button__label');
  label.textContent = text;
}
```

### 2. Hard-coded Values ❌

**Wrong:**
```css
.vf-button {
  background: #e60000;
  padding: 16px 24px;
}
```

**Right:**
```css
.vf-button {
  background: var(--vf-color-primary);
  padding: var(--vf-space-md) var(--vf-space-lg);
}
```

### 3. Missing Cleanup ❌

**Wrong:**
```javascript
class VfButton {
  constructor(element) {
    element.addEventListener('click', () => {
      // No cleanup!
    });
  }
}
```

**Right:**
```javascript
class VfButton {
  constructor(element) {
    this.handleClick = this.handleClick.bind(this);
    element.addEventListener('click', this.handleClick);
  }
  
  destroy() {
    this.element.removeEventListener('click', this.handleClick);
  }
}
```

### 4. Inaccessible Markup ❌

**Wrong:**
```html
<div onclick="handleClick()">Click me</div>
```

**Right:**
```html
<button type="button" onclick="handleClick()">Click me</button>
```

### 5. Missing RTL Support ❌

**Wrong:**
```css
.vf-button {
  margin-left: 16px;
  text-align: left;
}
```

**Right:**
```css
.vf-button {
  margin-inline-start: var(--vf-space-md);
  text-align: start;
}
```

## 📊 Quality Checklist

Before marking a component complete:

### Code Quality
- [ ] Valid, semantic HTML
- [ ] CSS uses design tokens exclusively
- [ ] JavaScript is clean and documented
- [ ] No console statements
- [ ] No unused code
- [ ] JSDoc comments complete

### Functionality
- [ ] All features work as expected
- [ ] Edge cases handled
- [ ] Error states handled
- [ ] Loading states work
- [ ] Public API methods work

### Accessibility
- [ ] WCAG 2.1 AA compliant
- [ ] Keyboard accessible
- [ ] Screen reader friendly
- [ ] Proper ARIA attributes
- [ ] Color contrast ≥ 4.5:1
- [ ] Touch targets ≥ 44x44px

### Responsiveness
- [ ] Works on mobile (320px+)
- [ ] Works on tablet (768px+)
- [ ] Works on desktop (1024px+)
- [ ] Touch-friendly on mobile
- [ ] Hover states on desktop

### RTL/LTR
- [ ] Layout mirrors in RTL
- [ ] Text aligns correctly
- [ ] Logical properties used
- [ ] Icons flip appropriately

### Browser Support
- [ ] Chrome/Edge 90+
- [ ] Firefox 88+
- [ ] Safari 14+
- [ ] Mobile browsers

### Testing
- [ ] Unit tests pass
- [ ] Coverage ≥ 80%
- [ ] Manual testing complete
- [ ] Playground tested

### Documentation
- [ ] README complete
- [ ] Usage examples provided
- [ ] API documented
- [ ] Known issues noted
